checks: Camera renders the gameplay canvas before photo; supported recorder exposes status, stops tracks and saves once.
Storage failure retains capture, blocks replacement and supports export / retry.
Gallery shows stored media, exports, requires delete confirmation and refreshes after deletion.
Unsupported recording and unavailable persistent storage are explicitly reported.
Music play/pause, track and volume controls call playback and persist preferences (audio API double).
Bundled tracks contain 24 seconds of non-silent PCM; server supplies audio/image MIME types and range playback.
limits: Controller/API doubles and HTTP asset tests. Actual WebGL pixels, IndexedDB persistence, codec playback, browser download and Android audio require device verification.
